(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
             (w (obj-w obj))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                         (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter frame? (objects g 0)))])
      (let* ((inside (filter (lambda (cell)
                               (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
                                 (and (> r (obj-r1 frame)) (< r (obj-r2 frame))
                                      (> c (obj-c1 frame)) (< c (obj-c2 frame))
                                      (not (= v 0)))))
                             (grid-cells g)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (map third inside)))
             (seed (first (filter (lambda (color)
                                    (= (length (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) inside)) 1))
                                  colors))))
        (for/fold ([acc out]) ([cell (in-list inside)])
          (if (= (third cell) seed)
              acc
              (set-cell acc (first cell) (second cell) seed)))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
             (w (obj-w obj))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                         (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (inside-cells frame)
      (filter (lambda (cell)
                (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
                  (and (> r (obj-r1 frame)) (< r (obj-r2 frame))
                       (> c (obj-c1 frame)) (< c (obj-c2 frame))
                       (not (= v 0)))))
              (grid-cells g)))
    (define (frame-info frame)
      (let* ((inside (inside-cells frame))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (map third inside)))
             (seed (first (filter (lambda (color)
                                    (= (length (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) inside)) 1))
                                  colors)))
             (target (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) seed))) inside)))
        (list frame seed (length target) inside)))
    (define (better-largest? a b)
      (let ((fa (first a)) (fb (first b)) (sa (third a)) (sb (third b)))
        (or (> sa sb)
            (and (= sa sb)
                 (or (< (obj-r1 fa) (obj-r1 fb))
                     (and (= (obj-r1 fa) (obj-r1 fb))
                          (< (obj-c1 fa) (obj-c1 fb))))))))
    ;; Stage A: parse every frame and select the frame whose enclosed target is largest.
    (define infos (map frame-info (filter frame? (objects g 0))))
    (define selected
      (for/fold ([best (first infos)]) ([info (in-list (rest infos))])
        (if (better-largest? info best) info best)))
    (define selected-seed (second selected))
    ;; Stage B: the selected seed color recolors every target, while local seeds remain.
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([info (in-list infos)])
      (let ((local-seed (second info)) (inside (fourth info)))
        (for/fold ([acc out]) ([cell (in-list inside)])
          (if (= (third cell) local-seed)
              acc
              (set-cell acc (first cell) (second cell) selected-seed)))))))
